entities.summary: Dame Alexandra Margaret Martin Hasluck, Lady Hasluck,, also known as Alix Hasluck, was an Australian author and social historian. She published a number of works on the history of Western Australia. She was the wife of Sir Paul Hasluck, Governor-General of Australia.
